issuer: the Washington State Department of Licensing (DOL)
note: The DOL fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives a first Washington licence at $111 for 6 years or $131 for 8 years, and a first ID card at $61 for 6 years or $81 for 8 years; both are held as terms the holder chooses, for the licence and the card. A licence issued under 18 is an intermediate licence whose restrictions end at 18 (RCW 46.20.075, read on the Legislature's site), so a full licence is kept from 18. No youngest age for an ID card was read. Not held: the enhanced licence and card, the reduced-fee card. On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms the holder chooses among: until then it held the 8-year licence and card only, and the 6-year option wasn't held.

sources.title: Washington DOL, Driver licensing fees
sources.said: First Washington driver license $111 for 6 years or $131 for 8 years ... Total ID card See Get your WA ID card $61 for 6 years or $81 for 8 years

sources.title: RCW 46.20.075, Intermediate license
sources.said: For the first six months after the issuance of an intermediate license or until the holder reaches 18 years of age, whichever occurs first
